thread:
Kevin (AE): Quick sync on ACME POC scope — we need aligned success criteria + a capacity/cost sketch for their trial starting May 4. Short summary below, please chime in.

Maria (SE): Got it. What are the primary flows + typical prompt sizes? Also target p95 latency and concurrent sessions?

Kevin (AE): Primary flows = 1) customer support chat (70%), 2) doc summarization (20%), 3) simple rerank/recall (10%). Average user message ~120 tokens, average model response ~140 tokens. For POC target we expect ~6k total active users over 4 weeks, average 3 queries/user/week -> ~72k requests. Peak concurrency estimate ~35 rps. Target p95 latency <= 500ms (generation-only).

Maria (SE): Nice. For evals they want a set of 200 prompts across top-20 intents + 50 doc summaries for quality checks. We'll need deterministic seeds for regen.

Tyler (Infra): Quick capacity sketch: 35 rps with avg output 140 tokens -> token throughput ~ (120+140)*35 = 9,100 tokens/sec ~ 546k tokens/min. With Redwood optimizations (KV cache for multi-turn) assume 20% reduction on chat tokens. Effective steady tokens/sec ~7,280.

Tyler (Infra): Rough GPU sizing options (rounded):
```
- Option A (cost-sensitive): 2 x A10G (40GB) with aggressive batching -> handles ~25-40 rps depending on batch latency tradeoff
- Option B (balanced): 1 x A100-40GB + autoscale 1 hot spare -> comfortable for ~35 rps with 95% headroom for spikes
- Option C (SLO-first): 2 x A100-80GB + prewarmed nodes -> <400ms p95 for 512 context and higher concurrency
```

Tyler (Infra): For POC I'd recommend Option B in Dedicated or Hosted Dedicated pool with burst policy.

Sam (Sales Eng): Can you throw some back-of-envelope cost numbers for a 4-week POC (Option B)? They asked finance to review.

Tyler (Infra): Sure — assumptions: A100-40GB equivalent price proxy $10/hr (for hosted reserved rate) per GPU; POC runs 24/7 for 4 weeks (672 hours). Use 1 primary + 1 spare autoscale fraction (~0.3 spare avg).

Tyler (Infra): Cost calc:
```
Base GPU hours = 1 * 672 = 672h
Spare (avg) = 0.3 * 672 = 201.6h
Total GPU hours = 873.6h -> round to 874h
GPU cost = 874h * $10/hr = $8,740
Estimated infra + network + storage add 25% -> ~$2,185
Estimated total infra = ~$10,925 (~$11k) for 4 weeks
```

Maria (SE): Also add Redwood platform usage (tokens) cost — estimate tokens: 72k requests * 260 tokens/request = 18,720,000 tokens. At hosted API rate example $0.15 per 1M tokens -> ~$2.80. But commercial pricing will differ; include embedding/rerank cost separately.

Maria (SE): Token cost calc:
```
Total tokens = 72,000 * 260 = 18,720,000 (~18.7M)
Token cost @ $0.15/1M = 18.72 * $0.15 = $2.81 (placeholder)
```

Kevin (AE): So combined rough POC budget = GPU infra ~$11k + platform/ops/SE support (estimate $6k for SE time + onboarding) + security review time. Ballpark = $18k-$25k. Presenting this to finance as a range.

Sam (Sales Eng): They'll likely push for <$20k. Can we compress to 3 weeks or reduce spare fraction?

Tyler (Infra): Yes — shorten to 3 weeks reduces GPU hours by 25% -> GPU cost drops to ~ $8.2k. Also set autoscale policy to 0.15 spare avg; that drops spare hours and another ~1.5k. Combined could put infra ~ $6.5-7k.

Maria (SE): Operational checklist for POC success (for SOW):
- Clear success metrics: p95 <500ms, end-user NPS >= +30 vs baseline, 85% intent match on eval set
- Test harness: 200 prompts, 50 doc summaries, 100 rerank queries (gold labels)
- Data handling: TLS in transit, no long-term storage of PII in logs, KMS for keys (if they require)
- Security gating: SOC2 report + data residency note (EU)

Kevin (AE): ACME is asking about a security questionnaire; they're enterprise. Can we support SOC2 + mention Private option for EU data?

Maria (SE): Yes — we can provide SOC2 cert copy and Private deployment option (VPC) if they want data to stay in their region. That will add operational lead time (~2-3 weeks). For the POC we can do Hosted Dedicated with region selector to satisfy them short-term.

deploy-bot: scheduled-deploy: New POC blueprint "acme-support-trial" created in staging cluster. ID: bp-acme-2026-03

Tyler (Infra): Timeline proposal:
- Week -1: finalize SOW + security checklist signed
- Week 0 (kickoff): deploy dedicated pool, seed prompts, baseline evals (2 days)
- Weeks 1-3: live testing and monitoring, daily eval runs, quality checkpoints
- Week 4: wrap, final eval, handoff + lessons learned

Kevin (AE): Perfect. Maria/Tyler, can you send a short summary and the cost range to ACME by EOD? I'll attach to the SOW draft.

Maria (SE): Will do — I'll include the eval list and the minimal prompt set.

Tyler (Infra): I'll attach the infra options and the preferred autoscale config.

Sam (Sales Eng): I'll flag finance for pricing approval.

Kevin (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
